Backend Developer

Your day to day:

We’re looking for a skilled Backend Developer to join our team and help us design and build robust, scalable, and efficient backend services. Your primary focus will be working with Java (11+) and Spring Boot, but we also welcome experience with other backend technologies like Golang.

With these activities you will have a great impact on our business:

Design, develop, and maintain backend services and APIs
Collaborate with frontend developers, DevOps, QA, and product teams to deliver high-quality features
Build scalable microservices and event-driven architectures
Ensure high availability and performance of backend systems,write clean, testable, and maintainable code with unit and integration tests
Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve issues in real-time during testing phases,contribute to continuous improvement of development practices and CI/CD pipelines


With these skills you are a great candidate:

Proficiency in REST API design, development & integration
Security best practices in backend development
Solid grasp of Unit Testing and TDD
Exposure to Kafka or similar messaging platforms (RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, etc.)
Understanding of CI/CD pipelines,familiarity with microservices and event-driven architecture


Must have technical / professional qualifications:

Strong experience with Java 8+ and Spring Boot
Solid knowledge of Git and version control best practices
Familiarity with Docker or other containerization tools
Cloud environment familiarity (AWS, GCP, Azure—any is welcome)
Bonus points for experience with Golang
